name: Help! After Pulling One Too Many All-Nighters, The Objects Around Me Have Turned Into Men!
source:
As a struggling art major, you're starting to regret life. You worked your butt off to get into your current college and major and now you're in the struggle bus. After one too many all-nighters in a row, you wake up to see that your personal  belongings have turned into men?!
